text:
Bea (design): quick check on the bulk-create UI. two open items: 1) how should we surface validation when users paste 30+ rows? inline error badges for each cell or a concise summary at the top with anchors? 2) required indicator: tiny asterisk only vs explicit 'Required' label visible by default?
Pri (pm): for pasted lists i prefer a top summary + jump-to-error. less visual noise for power users. inline when users edit single rows.
Owen (eng): perf: rendering thousands of inline error nodes kills paint on slower devices. idea: render summary after submit; mount inline messages lazily when a row is focused. cheap and effective.
Zoe (a11y): asterisk alone is inconsistent across ATs. recommend visible "Required" or at minimum aria-required=true + a visually-hidden text that reads "Required" tied by aria-describedby. also add aria-live="polite" to the summary so SRs get notified after submit.
Bea (design): tone/copy: current terse "Missing value" -> propose friendly + actionable "Please provide a value for [field]." Also thinking: summary header "We found 4 issues" vs "Please fix these errors". which reads less blamey?
Pri (pm): "We found 4 issues" is neutral.
Owen (eng): implementation note: add skip link target for keyboard users. anchors should move focus to the field and announce the error via aria-live region.
Zoe (a11y): if we use typed confirm for destructive deletes, ensure the SR hears exact instructions and the textfield is focused. avoid unexpected focus traps. for bulk deletes prefer undo toast if backend retention exists.
Bea (design): proposed pattern to prototype: summary-first (count + anchor links) after submit, inline error detail lazy-mounted on focus/blur, asterisk visually + sr-only "Required" for ATs, tooltip on hover for sighted users.
OpsBot: automated note: mock uploaded -> /design/mocks/bulk-forms/variant-A.png
Pri (pm): let's run a 6-person usability quick test (3 power users, 3 new users). if results lean summary-first, we'll update the form component and docs.
Owen (eng): I'll prototype lazy rendering and test with a 500-row fixture tomorrow.
Zoe (a11y): I'll do NVDA + VoiceOver checks once the prototype is live. checklist: skip-to-errors, aria-live polite, anchors move focus, clear SR phrasing.
Bea (design): thanks all — i'll post clickable mocks by EOD. react with :one: for inline-eager or :two: for summary-first.
